{{Citation}}
{{Quote|Well, Calrissian? Did he survive?"<br />"Yes, he's alive...and in perfect hibernation.|Darth Vader and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], after Han Solo is frozen in carbonite|<ref name="EPV">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
[[File:Carbo_cut_away.jpg|thumb|250px|A cut away shows the inner workings of a carbonite block used for transporting tibanna gas.]]
'''Carbonite''' was a metal alloy that was made from [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]. It was mixed with [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]], compressed, and [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|flash-frozen]] into blocks for transportation.

==Description==
Scalding liquid carbonite was used to encase [[spin-sealed]] [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] for transport on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Liquid cooling agents flash-froze the carbonite around the gas molecules, which were held in place by miniature [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic fields]], forming an airtight block.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|What if he doesn't survive? He's worth a lot to me.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] referring to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="EPV" />}}
[[File:HanCarbonite-BHUSC.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], frozen in a carbonite block]]
The [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] was a source of carbonite. The discovery that carbonite could be used to freeze [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] for their long journeys among the stars put an end to the [[Generation ship/Legends|generation ships]]. Shortly afterwards, they created [[Sleeper ship/Legends|Sleeper Ships]] utilizing this technology. [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]] became a boomworld and one of the strongholds of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Polus]] also had vast quantities of the metal alloy in its frozen wastelands. The [[Pyn'gani|inhabitants of Polus]] played a major role in the freezing process and mining.<ref name="EAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''&mdash;In-game descriptions</ref>

There were numerous times when individuals encased themselves in carbonite. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], a year before the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] invaded [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[I-5YQ]] froze himself and [[Lorn Pavan]] in carbonite to survive an explosion set off by [[Darsha Assant]] during her duel with [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> Sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] encased himself and his team in carbonite to be [[Battle of Gwori|sent]] undetected to the planet [[Gwori]]. However, one clone named [[Toomer]], was unable to be thawed because his slab was damaged, so they had to keep him safe until they were back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="sod">''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''</ref> and later used this method on another [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|mission]].<ref name="citadel">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref>

[[Filba]] used carbonite for smuggling [[Bota/Legends|bota]] harvested on [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the Clone Wars to preserve its quality. Some of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhooks]] were tethered to the surface with carbonite nanofiber.<ref name="coruscantii">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', 16</ref>

In some locales, carbonite was also used to preserve the bodies of the dead. On Coruscant, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Viento]] was buried in this manner in the [[Senatorial Tombs]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was frozen in carbonite on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] orders to test whether a [[Human/Legends|Human]] could survive Bespin's freezing process before his plan to freeze [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The modifications to the freezing chamber were successful in that Solo lived through the freezing process and entered into [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]].<ref name="EPV" /> This state also served as an art piece of Vader's creation. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] dubbed it, ''"[[Man in Carbonite]]"'', enticing Jabba to pay a significantly higher price for Solo. [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] also became a subject of art in this manner prior to his death. [[Moruth Doole]] froze the body of the former warden of the [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] prison system in carbonite in his office as a trophy.<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> While imprisoned in carbonite, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] could not use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], or interact with it on any significant level, making it a useful [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] containment tool. A common part of a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was a [[carbonite insert]].<ref name="DEII">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''</ref>

The usage of carbonite was obvious even for military purposes and [[carbonite gun]]s were made, used to spray a target in carbonite to freeze and paralyze the enemy. Those existed since during the time of the Old Republic,<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> while early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used [[carbonite war droid]]s. There was at least one case of carbonite war droids spraying an entire village in carbonite. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Mirta Gev]] discovered that Fett's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Sintas Vel]], had not died, but had been imprisoned in carbonite.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> The usage of such carbonite-based weapons continued through the Civil War.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref>

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], just a couple of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the end of the Second Galactic Civil War, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] utilized carbonite to imprison violent Jedi that were succumbing to a mysterious [[Force psychosis]]. Carbonite was seen as the only means to contain the Jedi due to the relatively safe incapacitating effect of carbonite encasement. There were some [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] beings that could break free of carbonite restraints, however, including [[Galen Marek]] and [[Subject 1138|his clone]].

[[Imperial Knight]] [[Antares Draco]] was frozen in carbonite in [[138 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
This substance should not be confused with the real-world [[Wikipedia:Carbonite (explosive)|coal-mining explosive]].
